name: TC-222: enabling the processing fee adds a Processing Fee line and raises the wind checkout total
description: A company admin turns ON pass-processing-fee for the restaurant (server-side; an owner's attempt to switch it on is ignored — checked first). The template-wind checkout order summary then shows a server-authoritative 'Processing Fee (credit cards)' line and the quoted Total rises above the fee-OFF baseline. Proves the flag → /quote → customer display round-trip end-to-end. The fee is always restored to OFF in a finally (shared QA restaurant).
